name: GSK
notes: Revenue = Turnover (Group turnover, total reported). operatingIncome = total reported Operating profit (not core). Bases: 2000-2002 UK GAAP (statutory totals incl. merger/restructuring items); 2003-2004 unaudited IFRS restatement; 2005+ IFRS. 2000 operatingIncome is UK GAAP 'Trading profit' (Operating profit row not sourced; for 2001 trading 4,697 vs operating 4,734). 2001 restated for FRS 19, 2007 restated, 2011/2012 restated for IAS 19R. 2015 operating profit inflated by Novartis transaction disposal gains. 2015-2025 from SEC XBRL companyconcept API (revenue URL as sourceUrl; operating profit from ProfitLossFromOperatingActivities endpoint). 2021 is as originally reported incl. Consumer Healthcare; 2022+ continuing operations after July 2022 Haleon demerger (2021 restated continuing ops not used), so a basis break exists at 2021/2022. FY2000 omitted: only a trading-profit line was available, not operating profit.
